title: Forensic Confirmation of Unauthorized VoterTrack Session

fields.headline: CISA Forensic Log Confirms Breach
fields.narration: A forensic log from LCBOE-SQL01 has been received from the managed SOC. The log confirms an unauthorized session on October 29, 2026, from IP address 10.100.45.12, which is not in any authorized IP range. The session lasted 35 minutes, from 02:05 to 02:40, and used a non-standard browser user agent. MFA was approved from Nina Ruiz’s iPhone13-773A, but no physical device was present in the office. The session modified 1,186 records in Precincts 111 and 112, changing the 'Absentee Ballot Status' field to 'received'. No local login event was recorded between 02:00 and 02:50.
keyFacts: .10.100.45.12 is not in any authorized IP range.
MFA was approved but no device was present.
1,186 records in Precincts 111 and 112 were edited.
No local login event from 02:00 to 02:50.
fields.expectedAction: IT and VSM confirm that VoterTrack must be isolated immediately; the forensic evidence confirms a breach. Begin manual operations using the trusted pollbook build from 10/28 and the offline copy on LCBOE-PB01. No further system access is permitted until forensic review is complete.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the attacker's access was not local and used stolen credentials. Watch for players to initiate isolation and switch to manual procedures.
